title: Oura Ring header
description: A quiet cream announcement strip over a 90px bar that floats on the hero: a light, widely tracked wordmark left, four nav links with small chevrons centred, a round outlined cart right, on a sand-to-clear wash. On phones the bar becomes a frosted pill floating at the top of the screen once the hero has scrolled away (wordmark, cart, menu). Once scrolled a solid backdrop fades in; the bar slides away while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up.
notes: sticky: its root is display:contents, so the bar sticks within the page wrapper; the bar takes no height (it overlays the block after it, e.g. the hero)
phones: the nav is a pill fixed 12px from the top that appears after 70% of the first screen is scrolled; without JavaScript it stays hidden
needs JavaScript for the scroll states and the phone menu (hydrate load); static HTML shows the bar
name: ouraring-header
